_doc: 353 nursery page, author pick B 花槽 (2026-11-21). Coordinates are for the content area of the left panel (598x850 at a 1600x900 capture; scale with the panel). Samples: https://claude.ai/artifact/55hVsaAb37Bz96sjwmvoFC (B row).
background: outdoor farm painting bg_farm.png from 静态美术设计 (author 11-21, Roman villa rustica); until it lands, the wood wall shows through. Text on the background uses the light ink #f1e3c2

plant.stage: 0 seed (just sown) / 1 sprout / 2 young / 3 ripe; pick by progress: runs_done/runs -> 0..2, ripe -> 3; empty bed -> none, show a dashed outline only

ripe.glow: ripe_glow.png behind the plant, scaled to the plant size
ripe.sparkles: sparkle.png x3 around the plant (22, 16, 14 px)

tag.content: crop name (bold 19) + one pip per run: pip_grow_on.png for runs done, pip_grow_off.png for runs left

below_shelf_empty: two parchment slips (existing commission torn-paper slip style + pin_growers.png), one per crop: plant_<crop>_3 at 110px, name, seed icon x1 (or emblem_growers + 送) -> product icon xN, hourglass + N 局, key 种下 (disabled when no seed)

below_shelf_growing.yield: product icon xN under the basket, 60% opacity while growing

below_shelf_ripe: product icon (80px) sitting in the basket, yield at full opacity, primary key 收获 under it

ripe_mark.use: replaces the text 「可收获」 after 后勤 tab (26px) and 苗圃 sub-key (20px); tooltip keeps the text

nursery_locked_board: add emblem_growers.png beside 河滩垦户社
